Her research focus was further refined during her graduate studies, when she delved deeper into the realm of environmental sustainability and conservation. Wifak's academic achievements at Mohammed V University were not limited to her research pursuits. Her work has also been recognized with several awards, including the prestigious Governor General's Gold Medal. As Bengarai continues to make waves in the academic community, her alma mater is taking notice. "Wifak's success is a testament to the quality of education and research opportunities available at the University of Guelph," said Dr. Franco Vaccarino, President of the University of Guelph.
